summary:
A Sr. Staff Engineer at Tesla AI dropped an ML time breakdown that nobody dares to face:
50% evaluation, 40% data cleaning, 8% integration, 2% training.
The post got shared over 2,000 times, and everyone was shocked that training only takes 2%.
But the truly terrifying part is
Many people think any given ML project is 99% training.
In reality, it’s 50% evaluation, 40% data cleaning, 8% integration, and 2% training.
The first two set the noise floor for learning. No ML magic matters; the model cannot lower the noise floor, as that’s the optimal bound
